newsitem.title: CHINA: Yuan closes down at intraday low vs US dollar.
newsitem.headline: Yuan closes down at intraday low vs US dollar.

text.p: The Chinese yuan closed at an intraday low of 8.2945 on Monday, slightly down from 8.2940 last Friday against the U.S. dollar in Shanghai. Trading was dull with some speculative selling before the close, dealers said.
The weighted average price last Friday was 8.2941.
Dealers said a lack of market-moving news dampened interest and most investors had decided to stick to the sidelines.
The yuan opened higher at 8.2930 and hit an intraday high of 8.2926 early in the trading day. It then crawled down to move in a range of 8.2935 and 8.2940 before sliding further.
"The market is lacking fresh news after Deng Xiaoping's death, so trading volume is low," said one dealer.
Another dealer said no central bank intervention had been seen on Monday, but as the central bank had depressed the yuan last week, the currency was likely to fall further this week.
Dealers said they expected the yuan to touch the 8.2950 support level on Tuesday.
The yuan closed down at 6.7635 from 6.7388 against 100 Japanese yen and down at an intraday low of 1.0720 from 1.0715 against the Hong Kong dollar.
